description: As part of this package, Reilly is introducing legislation intended to mitigate the serial theft of low-dollar items by permitting prosecutors to aggregate charges within an 18-month period, potentially elevating Petit Larceny – a theft of less than $1,000 – to Grand Larceny – a theft exceeding $1,000 and up to as much as $1,000,000. In some cases, this would also make the qualifying offense bail eligible.
